evidence: Modifies transaction creation, coin selection, fee bumping, database persistence, and wallet RPCs across `src/wallet/` to implement BIP 352 Silent Payment sending.
rationale: Adds user-facing BIP 352 Silent Payment sending support to the wallet, resolving a major privacy limitation where users could not send to silent payment addresses. Adapts core coin selection and derivation logic during transaction creation, with substantial durable value for wallet users.
